page_title: puppyone — The folder your agents live in

summary.name: puppyone
summary.one_liner: puppyone is a folder that Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other AI agents can work in together, on your computer or in a cloud-hosted version, with every change tracked and reversible.
use_cases: let Claude Code and Cursor edit the same project files
review and undo changes made by AI agents
keep agents running on a cloud folder while laptop is closed
share a folder with teammates and multiple agents
self-host an agent file store on own infrastructure
summary.what_it_does: puppyone lets you open any folder on your computer so agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode can read and write the same files. Git is built in, so you can see each agent's diff and restore earlier versions. The optional puppyone Cloud keeps the same folder online around the clock, lets agents on other devices or CI continue from where others stopped, and gives each agent its own scoped key over MCP, REST API or CLI. Every write in the cloud is saved as a version tagged with the agent that made it. The cloud server is also available as open source (Community Edition) for self-hosting with Docker.
notable: Git-based version history with diff review and restore for every agent change
Works with 40+ agents including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode
Per-agent scoped keys over MCP, REST API or CLI
Cloud server open source (Community Edition) and self-hostable with Docker
caveats: puppyone Cloud is a paid add-on for always-on access, teammates, more storage and longer version history
Platforms named on the page are limited; the desktop app platform is not explicitly stated beyond the listing context
